name: treasure-of-the-depths-with-three-refinement-counters-pays-three-and-draws-into-memory
notes: Treasure of the Depths had no implementation of its activated ability. Registered as a field activation: ActivatedAbilityCost rests it and queues three reserve payments; the prereq requires three refinement counters.

rulesClauses: (3), [REST]: Draw a card into your memory. Activate this ability only if there are three or more refinement counters on CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: Treasure of the Depths's activated ability was not implemented.
